newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after hours.

text.p: After-hours trading was quiet on Thursday, traders said.
Shortly after the market closed, Staples Inc posted third-quarter earnings of $0.19 per share compared to $0.13 per share and Nike Inc boosted its quarterly dividend 33 percent to $0.10 per share.
Alliance Entertainment Corp outlined a consolidation and staff-cutting plan after reporting a third-quarter loss of $0.23 per share compared to a profit of $0.03 per share a year earlier.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 8,700 shares compared with 30,700 shares on Wednesday. Session two volume was 1,769,400 shares compared with no volume on Wednesday.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
